immutable_rule: Record the owner-controlled UTC acquisition event against the immutable archive checksum; never derive it from publication date, as-of date, filesystem metadata, or migration time.

field_contracts.definition: UTC timestamp when the owner acquired the exact checksummed archive.

correction_rule.behavior: append a corrected immutable event; never overwrite or infer a timestamp

release_rules.authorized: restricted freshness processing after owner event is supplied

field_contracts.limitation: No current ledger contains trustworthy historical acquisition events, so real freshness remains unreleased.
